about: Each case calls the named rule from lib/opportunities/normalize.ts with `args` and checks the result. Programs are built from `program` over a default one-off with one application phase 2026-03-01..2026-04-01.

evals.name: one-off-open-on-last-day
assertions: The last date itself is still open

evals.name: one-off-expires-next-day
assertions: One-offs are removed the day after their last date

evals.name: recurring-never-expires
assertions: Recurring programs roll forward instead of being deleted

evals.name: recurring-rolls-to-next-cycle
assertions: Year in the name moves with the dates
Rolled dates are marked as usual timing and estimated

evals.name: grant-kind-from-tags
assertions: Old seed rows without kind get it from their tags
